hero.badge: Designed for students, developers, and Minecraft server owners
hero.title: TaiwanFRP
hero.subtitle_line1: Easily connect your local server, hidden behind a NAT or firewall, to the internet
hero.subtitle_line2: No public IP needed, no router configuration required. We provide a free and stable internal network penetration service, making it easy for you to go live with your exclusive game server and development projects.

what_is_frp.title_line1: What is a reverse proxy tunnel (FRP)?
what_is_frp.paragraph1: In a typical network environment (such as a community network, school, or office), devices are often behind a complex network setup, facing frequently changing dynamic IPs and often being unable to log into the router to configure port forwarding. This makes it impossible for the outside network to reliably reach services running on your computer or server.
what_is_frp.paragraph2: FRP (Fast Reverse Proxy) was created to solve exactly this pain point. It actively establishes an encrypted, secure tunnel between a "node with a fixed public IP" and "your local host", forwarding external requests precisely back to your local machine, so you never have to deal with complicated router configuration again.

why_use_frp.title: What can you use it for?
why_use_frp.subtitle: Break through network restrictions with a lightweight, flexible, and privacy-friendly connection solution.
why_use_frp.case1_desc: No need to rent a VPS just for a single port. Perfectly solves Ngrok's high-latency pain point, providing blazing-fast external connections for local projects, API testing, or personal websites.
why_use_frp.case2_desc: Self-host a Minecraft or Palworld server, and let your friends connect directly without installing Radmin VPN. Enjoy low-latency gaming while keeping your real IP completely hidden for privacy.
why_use_frp.case3_desc: Need to connect back to your host while you're out? Ditch the commercial limits and slow connections of third-party tools like TeamViewer. Map SSH or Remote Desktop (RDP) ports to enjoy a high-bandwidth direct connection through a local Taiwan node.

service_features.title: Our Core Advantages
service_features.subtitle: Say goodbye to complicated commands and config files, and manage your reverse proxy tunnels the modern way.
service_features.feature1_desc: Fully compatible with Windows, Linux, ARM architectures, and Docker. No more messy local config files — just one command to start the connector and go fully automatic online.
service_features.feature2_title: Full Control from a Web Dashboard
service_features.feature2_desc: Move full control to the cloud. Adding tunnels, changing ports, monitoring traffic, and checking node status can all be done in real time through an intuitive visual dashboard.
service_features.feature3_desc: Complete OpenAPI (Swagger) documentation is provided, letting developers easily call the API to control and manage the service, and freely integrate it into their own applications.

open_source.desc: We understand how important security and trust are. Our core components are hosted on GitHub under the MIT and Apache-2.0 open-source licenses, keeping every line of code open, transparent, and open to community review, with contributions always welcome.
